node.statement: For c in U(1), conjugate linearity of dagger, bilinearity, and |c|=1 show (cU_i)^dagger bold-dot(cU_i)=J; scaling a right inverse of U_i by conjugate(c) supplies a right inverse of cU_i. Thus cU_i lies in calU, ||cU_1-cU_0||=||U_1-U_0||, and the rotated pair satisfies the same hypotheses. Its affine path is Z_t(cU_0,cU_1)=cZ_t, so both Z_t and cZ_t lie in S_delta.
